title: Fly to Hong Kong, harbour night
cond: Tokyo heavy rain early, Hong Kong cloudy
call: Rain until about 08:00, then clearing. tenki.jp's hourly for Chiyoda has about 1 mm an hour through the night, 2 mm at 02:00, still raining when you leave at about 06:30, cloudy and dry from 09:00, 16°. Its forecaster puts the peak tonight to dawn, with local bursts of about 30 mm an hour in southern Kanto. The taxi is the right call: allow extra time for wet roads, and check CX543 in the Cathay app before you leave. Light northerly wind, so take-off should be fine once the rain eases. Hong Kong: mostly cloudy, sunny spells later, 26 to 30°, a fresh easterly for the harbour cruise.
